__meta: REUSABLE. ACS Call Automation reliability from Log Analytics. Reliability timeseries: 1 - failed/total operations. percentunit, decimals 3, thresholds red / yellow@0.95 / green@0.99, thresholdsStyle area — the reliability-timeseries archetype from the reference dashboard, retargeted at ACS diagnostic logs.
title: ACS — Operation reliability
description: 1 − failed/total ACS Call Automation operations. Green ≥ 99%, amber ≥ 95%.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ACSCallAutomationIncomingOperations
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(ResultType != 'Succeeded') by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, Reliability = iff(Total == 0, 1.0, 1.0 - todouble(Failed) / Total)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
